notes.title: Stream Runners: Heroes at Emerald City Comic Con!
notes.notes:
[h1]Exciting news everyone![/h1]
Game Grotto Developers Don and Meg will be at Emerald City Comic Con, March 2nd - 5th.

We will be in the Exhibitor Hall at booth 10043 from 10am to 6pm all days of the convention. We will have teasers and trailers featuring the new indie game titles being worked on by Game Grotto, and an interactive Livestream on Twitch playing Stream Runners: Heroes LIVE at the Game Grotto booth!

If you are attending Emerald City Comic Con, please come see us. We'd love to meet you!
Don and Meg, Game Grotto Softworks.

notes.title: Launch Update - Midnight Release
notes.notes:
Great News everyone! Stream Runners: Heroes will be available for purchase tonight at midnight!

Thank you all so much for your patience, your support, and being all around awesome! It has been a lot of hard work to release this game. We are only two developers, an artist and a programmer, and with dedication and perseverance it was truly a pleasure to develop this game for our Twitch community. 

It all started when we wanted to give our chat something fun to play while we worked on artwork and development for our other indie game titles. Stream Runners evolved through the participation of our community, who offered their ideas for characters, enemies, themes, and eventually their suggestions for settings and options that could allow other streamers to use the game for all kinds of different things. 

We took all these ideas and input into our mixing pot of expertise and crafted a fun experience for Twitch streamers and their communities, big or small. Stream Runners is everything we hoped it would be, and we truly hope that you enjoy the game with your Twitch communities, like we do with ours.

Enjoy Stream Runners: Heroes, and you can bet Game Grotto will be live on Twitch making more indie games, so come stop by sometime and meet the developers and their community behind this little game for streamers.

Don and Meg, Game Grotto Softworks.

notes.title: Launch Delay
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I'm sure you have been wondering about Stream Runners: Heroes release, seeing as today is launch day. Well we have an update for you.

We submitted the final build of the game to Steam from review yesterday, and it is currently being reviewed by Steam for a clear to launch. 

During the BETA we received some excellent feedback from our testers and their communities, and we wanted to include updates to the base game's settings based on this feedback. These extra features include:

[i]1) a post-session scoreboard containing all three lanes points value and who killed a boss that game
2) a Runner multiplier toggle so that one redeem will spawn 3 runners
3) a redeem cooldown slider to decrease spam in the chat if so desired
4) a boss HP slider for creating challenges or easy boss slaying
5) the ability to turn off or on Runner colors (Red, Blue, and Green)[/i]

all these things as well as some balancing fixes - those green runners, they were invincible, they never died! So we fixed that bug too.

It's disappointing that we could not reach our launch date, as a publisher personally I want to meet the goals I set. I truly believe these additions will enhance the game and make it a wonderful tool for all the streamers who use it going forward. With these things considered, it set my mind at ease to simply push the launch date, and work on what mattered: getting the players and hosts the game they deserve.

So as Steam reviews this final build, this means Stream Runners: Heroes could be available between now and who knows - maybe even next Monday! It's not up to us to say. It's all in Steams hands now, and we hope the approval comes very soon, so you can all start playing SR: Heroes.

I will be keeping everyone updated with news as it happens here. Thank you all for your patience, your support, and for all your effort spreading the word about our game playing it on stream!

Meagan Gates, Game Grotto Softworks artist and CEO
